maia_docs: Heads-up: while updating the "Pricing & Usage" pages I ran into several small but customer-facing inconsistencies that should be fixed in one coordinated PR so the migration guide matches the API examples. Can we triage?
raj_eng: what's the checklist?
maia_docs: 1) The rate-limit error examples only show `retry_after` in seconds. The service now includes `retry_after_ms`. Docs should show both and explicitly recommend `retry_after_ms` as the source of truth.
maia_docs: 2) The pricing language is inconsistent: some places say "tokens" and some say "billing units". We need a short conversion reference (generation tokens -> units, embeddings per 1k vectors -> units) and a migration note for customers who used the older meter names.
maia_docs: 3) The metering console link in the doc points to an old path that redirects. Link-checker flagged it. Replace with the canonical console URL and mention that "Billing Viewer" is required to view per-tier breakdowns.
hannah_support: Support is seeing customers accidentally sleeping 1000x too long because they treated ms as seconds. A compact SDK snippet (JS + Python) showing ms-first fallback is high priority for the KB.
sdk-ella: I can add snippets + tiny unit tests for the docs CI. Draft JS snippet:```js
// prefer retry_after_ms, fallback to retry_after (s)
const payload = await resp.json();
const waitMs = payload.retry_after_ms ?? (payload.retry_after ? payload.retry_after * 1000 : null);
if (waitMs) await sleep(waitMs);
```
sdk-ella: Python:```py
payload = resp.json()
wait_ms = payload.get('retry_after_ms') or (payload.get('retry_after') and payload['retry_after'] * 1000)
if wait_ms:
    time.sleep(wait_ms / 1000)
```
raj_eng: also add a short snippet showing how to read the `x-burst-remaining` header so apps can surface burst capacity to end users. Small example:```js
const r = await client.generate(...)
console.log('burst remaining:', r.headers['x-burst-remaining'])
```
maia_docs: Good. For the console link update, please point to https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers and add a parenthetical: "(requires Billing Viewer role)". Also swap one large PNG screenshot for a small annotated SVG to reduce raster updates.
link-bot: Link-checker: current doc had 1 redirect to /usage/legacy. Replace with canonical console path to avoid redirect.
qa-bot: QA reminder: include snippet-tests in docs/tests/snippets so CI runs the code examples. Also add markdown-lint fix for long code lines.
hannah_support: Once the PR is open, please tag support and add a one-liner for the KB so we can push an update quickly.
maia_docs: Plan is a single PR with three commits: (A) rate-limit payload + SDK snippets + snippet-tests, (B) pricing wording + conversion reference + migration note, (C) console link + SVG screenshot. I'll open the draft PR and request reviews.
sdk-ella: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1205 (WIP). Assigning reviewers @raj_eng @hannah_support.
raj_eng: will review tomorrow AM. I'll also verify the exact conversion numbers for billing units.
maia_docs: Great. Follow-up infra ticket: expose `burst_used` metric in the usage API so dashboards can surface burst consumption by org (TKT-2210). Adding it to PR description as a follow-up.
hannah_support: thanks everyone 44d will prep KB update once PR lands.
maia_docs: Thanks all 44d closing the loop here.
